# How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Keyulu Xu, Weihua Hu, Jure Leskovek, Stefanie Jegelka  
**Year:** 2018  
**Journal:** ICLR  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1810.00826](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1810.00826)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.00826](https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.00826)

**Keywords:** gin, gnn

## Abstract

We analyze the expressive power of graph neural networks and show that they are at most as powerful as the Weisfeiler-Lehman test.
